title: Spec & Drift Detection
summary: An agentic spec and drift detection tool in CI/CD that catches UI inconsistencies before merge, cutting drift fixes by 33 %.

body.context: QA tickets tagged "UI inconsistency", "spec mismatch", or "outdated documentation" averaged 18 per release cycle.
body.contribution: Engineered an automated agentic spec and drift detection tool that runs in CI/CD and flags discrepancies before pull requests merge.
body.outcome: Drift tickets fell from 18 to 12 per release, with 6 caught upstream in pre-merge checks.
